business_briefs.market_context: This is a trust-and-results market with high lifetime value: one converted client can be years of rebookings. Competition includes both other local providers and the do-nothing option — most prospects delay for months. Credibility (reviews, credentials, consistent aesthetic) converts better than discounts, and word of mouth is amplified, not replaced, by ads.

business_briefs.seasonality: Peaks come ahead of event seasons — weddings and proms in spring, holidays in November-December — plus a strong New Year self-improvement wave. Treatments with lead times (a series of sessions, visible-results windows) should be marketed 6-8 weeks before the moment people want results, and January is for memberships and maintenance plans.

advantages: Mid-market sweet spot: premium feel without premium anchor pricing — name the price in the ad with confidence.
